H1.statement: At 0% corruption, B (graph only) is within practical margin of A (text only) or better: CI lower bound >= -0.03.

H2.statement: At 30% corruption, B is worse than A by more than margin: CI upper bound < -0.03.

H3.statement: At 30% corruption, C (text + graph) is not worse than A by more than margin (CI lower >= -0.03) and C is better than B by more than margin (CI lower > +0.03).

H4.statement: At 30% corruption, D (reconcile) beats F (matched second pass without reconciliation) by more than margin: CI lower bound > +0.03.

decision_classification_rule.inconclusive: Anything else (straddles bound or crosses zero with wide interval)
